name: Oh, Blossom!
source:
A strange forest and someone new make getting hit by a bus a lot more eventful than usual. 
Discover the secret behind the blossoms!

[from [url=https://armin.itch.io/oh-blossom]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一片奇异的森林，加上一位新认识的人，让被公交车撞到这件事，比平常更波折重重。
揭开花朵背后的秘密！

[摘自[url=https://armin.itch.io/oh-blossom]itch.io[/url]]
